import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
p=Path.cwd();s=(p/'src/URMatchingWeightedMoment.lean').read_text().replace('  rw [← nat_mul_sum, Nat.mul_assoc]\n  apply Nat.mul_le_mul_left','  rw [← nat_mul_sum]\n  rw [Nat.mul_assoc (2*(k+1))]\n  apply Nat.mul_le_mul_left').replace('  simpa only [← nat_mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_filter','  rw [nat_mul_sum]\n  simpa only [← Finset.sum_filter').replace('by rw [← Nat.mul_assoc 4 100]; rfl','by rw [show (400 : ℕ) = 4*100 from rfl]; simp only [Nat.mul_assoc]')
subprocess.run(['python3','-I','-B',str(p/'write_lane.py'),'src/URMatchingWeightedMoment.lean'],input=s,text=True,check=True)
